name: Slideshow
description: Photo slideshow in the TikTok photo-mode style: 6-9 photos, one big line of text per slide, no voice-over (add a trending sound when posting).

sections.guidance: Slide 1 is the scroll-stopper: a bold claim, 'things nobody tells you about…', 'POV:' or a numbered promise.
One idea per slide, max ~10 words, specific and relatable; build a list, a story, or a before/after.
Last slide is the twist/punchline or the takeaway; no follow/like CTA.

closing: End on a twist or punchline that makes people rewatch or share. No call to action.
